Irvine's bookstore since 2016.

Ines Calloway spent nineteen years as a school librarian before opening Paperwhale in a former video rental store. The old return slot in the door is our book drop now. Order online and we'll have it on the hold shelf in about two hours.

About the whale

There is a whale-shaped doorstop by the register. In 2016 Ines's daughter Maya, who was four, pointed at it and called it the paper whale. The shop was going to be named something much more serious.

Theo buys fiction and nonfiction and knits during slow Tuesdays. Mina runs the children's corner and reads aloud on Saturdays. Gus is the cat. He sleeps on the cookbook table and is not for sale.

If we don't have a book, we'll order it. It usually takes three or four days, and we text you when it's on the hold shelf.

Looking for something specific?

Tell us the title, or tell us the last book you loved and we'll guess. Theo and Mina read these, and one of them usually answers within the hour.

Or text (949) 555-0119.
